name: motif_add_feature_structure
description:
Author grammatical features. Research first: motif_guide topic feature-conditioned-slots; check best practice. Restrict a slot's affix by feature value; do not copy affixes or slots per value. Arbitrary lexical grouping is an inflection class (guide feature-conditioned-slots). Stages an empty feature structure on an existing or earlier-staged stem, inflectional affix or derivational affix MSA (side from or to) in a Draft, refusing an occupied slot even when its structure has no selections. Inflectional affix features are word requirements; use the returned exact structure identity to author selections. Only a person can Apply.
Command: compose-author-feature-structure. Agent class: Draft.
DraftName: The name of the Draft being authored.
IntentJson: Closed {msa, side?} input naming the exact canonical MSA identity; side (from or to) is required for a derivational affix and refused otherwise. Its MsFeatures, InflFeats, FromMsFeatures or ToMsFeatures owning slot must be unoccupied; a present structure is refused even with no selections. Inflectional affix features are word requirements. Use the returned structure identity for selections.

name: motif_add_lexical_entry

An inflectional affix can name the inflection classes its form attaches to; use compose-edit-derivational-affix-restriction for a derivational affix. name: motif_add_affix_process
description:
Author an affix process. Research first: motif_guide topic workflow or conditioned-allomorphs; check best practice. Use for infixes, reduplication and stem-internal changes. Another pattern-based form of an existing entry: compose-author-affix-process-allomorph. Regular nasal assimilation is a phonological rule (guide nasal-assimilation). Stages a new affix entry whose ordered input pattern matches phonemes, a natural class or the remaining stem, and whose output copies named parts, inserts phonemes, inserts a segment of a natural class, or copies a part with the features of a feature class laid over it: an infix, a partial or full reduplication, or a substitution that deletes matched input by omitting it from the output (Cebuano paN- before p/b gives m). It refuses an output that copies nothing or drops the remaining stem. Dry Run and Trial before a person Applies the Proposal.
Command: compose-author-affix-process. Agent class: Draft.

An input part left out of the output is deleted.

Stages one more pattern-based form, an affix process with its own input pattern and output, on an existing affix entry whose forms may be plain allomorphs or processes. The lexeme form's morph type is copied and the form applies to all of the entry's grammatical info. It refuses a stem, a repeated pattern and a missing placement.
Command: compose-author-affix-process-allomorph. Agent class: Draft.

entry.description: Id of the existing affix entry that gains the process.

input.description: Ordered pattern parts, each with a name and one of phoneme, naturalClass or remaining true; the remaining-stem part is last.

output.description: Ordered realization, each item exactly one of: copy of a named input part; insert of phoneme ids; insertClass, the id of a natural class one of whose segments is inserted (a class of several segments leaves the choice of member to the parser); modify, the name of an input part (a phoneme, a natural class or the remaining stem), with features, the id of a feature natural class laid over the copied part. name: motif_author_adhoc_prohibition
description:
Create an ad hoc prohibition. Research first: motif_guide topic ask-the-linguist or suffix-prefix-slots or feature-conditioned-slots; check best practice. Last resort. Prefer a slot, template, feature or environment that removes the need before forbidding a combination (guides suffix-prefix-slots, feature-conditioned-slots). Creates a morpheme or allomorph co-occurrence prohibition, FieldWorks' ad hoc rule, naming a first morpheme or allomorph and the ones it cannot occur with. The Dry Run says plainly what is prohibited next to what; duplicates and unknown morphemes or allomorphs are refused, and only a person can Apply the Draft.

name: motif_delete_affix_process
description:
Delete an affix process. Research first: motif_guide topic conditioned-allomorphs; check best practice. Replace a pattern with a plain form after moving or removing every incoming reference (guide conditioned-allomorphs). name: motif_change_affix_kind
description:
Change an affix’s kind. Research first: motif_guide topic suffix-prefix-slots; check best practice. Choose inflectional or derivational on the evidence and change it later if it was wrong; leaving an affix unclassified is a stopgap (guides suffix-prefix-slots). Stages a change of one affix between inflectional, derivational and unclassified in place, keeping its category and the senses that use it. What the new kind cannot hold, such as a template slot or a To category, is reported as a warning, not refused. Dry Run and Trial before a person Applies the Proposal.

msa.description: Id of the affix’s current grammatical info.

kind.description: New kind: inflectional, derivational or unclassified.

name: motif_edit_phoneme
description:
Edit a phoneme's representations. Research first: motif_guide topic nasal-assimilation or conditioned-allomorphs; check best practice. Edit a phoneme for a real contrast, not only to record a surface variant, unless a rule needs it as an output segment (guides nasal-assimilation, conditioned-allomorphs). Stages new written representations for an existing phoneme, or respells one it has, so a multigraph such as ng, ts or dy is another way the same segment is written and never a second phoneme. It refuses a spelling another phoneme or boundary already has, and a respelling that an environment writes. Dry Run and Trial before a person Applies the Proposal.
Command: compose-edit-phoneme. Agent class: Draft.

target.description: Id of the existing phoneme.

add.description: New representations to append, each an object with a representation, such as ng.

respell.description: Current representations to replace in place, each with from and to.

name: motif_add_phonological_feature
description:
Author a phonological feature. Research first: motif_guide topic nasal-assimilation or archiphonemes; check best practice. Use for a phonological feature of sounds. An inflection or part-of-speech feature uses compose-author-inflection-feature; a word-level exception uses compose-author-exception-feature (guide archiphonemes). Stages a closed phonological feature and its values in the project's phonological feature system, such as place with labial, coronal and velar. Phonemes carry the values and a natural class can be defined by them. Defining the first feature of a featureless project changes how rewrite rules that name segment classes are read, so Trial the rules after it. Only a person can Apply.
Command: compose-author-phonological-feature. Agent class: Draft.

abbreviation.description: Optional feature abbreviation, unique among phonological features.

values.description: Nonempty list of values, each an object with a name and an optional abbreviation; select one later in a batch with @label:values:NAME.

name: motif_add_phonological_feature_value
description:
Add a phonological feature value. Research first: motif_guide topic nasal-assimilation; check best practice. Extend a feature that exists. Create the feature first with compose-author-phonological-feature (guide nasal-assimilation). Stages one more value for an existing closed phonological feature. The feature must belong to the phonological feature system, and the value name and abbreviation must be new to it. Only a person can Apply.
Command: compose-add-phonological-feature-value. Agent class: Draft.

feature.description: Id of a saved or earlier staged phonological feature, @label in a batch, or lookup:phonological-feature:NAME.

abbreviation.description: Optional value abbreviation, unique within the feature.

project.description: Known project name or recorded .fwdata path.

name: motif_edit_phoneme_features
description:
Set a phoneme's features. Research first: motif_guide topic nasal-assimilation or archiphonemes; check best practice. Set the features of a phoneme that exists; a new phoneme can take features when it is authored (guides nasal-assimilation, archiphonemes). Stages feature values on an existing phoneme: set a value (a feature the phoneme already has takes the new value in place, one it lacks gains it) and clear features. A phoneme with no feature structure gets one. It refuses a value that does not belong to its feature, a feature both set and cleared, a clear of an absent feature and a change that alters nothing. Only a person can Apply.
Command: compose-edit-phoneme-features. Agent class: Draft.

target.description: Id of the existing phoneme.

set.description: Feature and value pairs to set, each an object with feature and value ids.

clear.description: Ids of features whose specification is removed.

name: motif_edit_natural_class_features
description:
Edit a natural class's features. Research first: motif_guide topic nasal-assimilation; check best practice. Change the feature constraints of a class defined by features. A class defined by segments changes its members with compose-edit-natural-class (guide nasal-assimilation). Stages a change to the feature values that define a feature-based natural class: set a constraint (a feature the class already constrains takes the new value in place) and clear constraints. The class must keep at least one constraint, and a segment class is refused. The response lists the environments, rules and insertions that use the class. Only a person can Apply.
Command: compose-edit-natural-class-features. Agent class: Draft.

target.description: Id of the existing feature-based natural class.

set.description: Feature and value pairs to set, each an object with feature and value ids.

clear.description: Ids of features whose constraint is removed.

project.description: Known project name or recorded .fwdata path.

name: motif_merge_phoneme
description:
Merge a phoneme into another. Research first: motif_guide topic nasal-assimilation or conditioned-allomorphs; check best practice. Merge phonemes only when the language has no contrast between them, since the contrast cannot be recovered from the words afterwards (guides nasal-assimilation, conditioned-allomorphs). Stages a merge of one phoneme into another: each spelling of the first becomes another way to write the second, and the first phoneme is removed from the inventory and from its natural classes. It refuses a spelling another phoneme has, a natural class the first phoneme alone fills, and a rule or environment that uses the first phoneme. Dry Run and Trial before a person Applies the Proposal.
Command: compose-merge-phoneme. Agent class: Draft.

source.description: Id of the phoneme to merge away.

target.description: Id of the phoneme that keeps its identity and gains the spellings.

project.description: Known project name or recorded .fwdata path.

name: motif_split_phoneme
description:
Split a spelling into a phoneme. Research first: motif_guide topic nasal-assimilation or conditioned-allomorphs; check best practice. Split a spelling out only for a real contrast, then add the new phoneme to its natural classes (guides nasal-assimilation, conditioned-allomorphs). Stages the move of one spelling of a phoneme into a new phoneme of its own, which undoes a merge. The phoneme keeps its other spellings, and the new phoneme starts with no natural class and no features. It refuses a spelling an environment writes. Dry Run and Trial before a person Applies the Proposal.
Command: compose-split-phoneme. Agent class: Draft.

source.description: Id of the phoneme that has the spelling now.

representation.description: The spelling to move out, such as o.

project.description: Known project name or recorded .fwdata path.

name: motif_edit_derivational_affix_restriction
description:
Restrict a derivational affix. Research first: motif_guide topic suffix-prefix-slots; check best practice. For a derivational affix only. An inflectional affix is restricted by the inflection classes on its form (compose-edit-affix-inflection-classes). Sets, replaces or explicitly clears the From Inflection Class and the To Inflection Class, and can set the exact From Exception Features and To Exception Features on an existing affix entry's derivational grammatical info; alsoMsas applies the same change to many affixes. Omitted fields stay unchanged. Motif stages a Draft for a person to review and Apply.
Command: compose-edit-derivational-affix-restriction. Agent class: Draft.

msa.description: Id of the derivational grammatical info of an existing affix entry.

fromInflectionClass.description: Optional id of an inflection class owned by the From category or an ancestor; omission leaves the current link unchanged.

clearFromInflectionClass.description: Set true to remove the current From Inflection Class; do not combine with fromInflectionClass.

fromExceptionFeatures.description: Optional exact set of valid From Exception Features; an empty list removes them all, and omission leaves the current set unchanged.

toInflectionClass.description: Optional id of an inflection class owned by the To category or an ancestor; derived stems get this class. Omission leaves the current link unchanged.

clearToInflectionClass.description: Set true to remove the current To Inflection Class; do not combine with toInflectionClass.

toExceptionFeatures.description: Optional exact set of To Exception Features, which the derived stem receives; an empty list removes them all, and omission leaves the current set unchanged.

alsoMsas.description: Optional ids of further derivational grammatical info that receive the identical change, so one intent edits many affixes.

project.description: Known project name or recorded .fwdata path.

name: motif_author_exception_feature
description:
Add an exception feature. Research first: motif_guide topic suffix-prefix-slots; check best practice. Add a feature only for a lexical class with a reason, since a feature per stem is just a stem list (guides suffix-prefix-slots). Stages a new exception feature in the project's Exception Features list, the tag that stems carry and affixes or rules can require. It refuses a name the list already has. Only a person can Apply.
Command: compose-author-exception-feature. Agent class: Draft.

name.description: Name of the feature, such as the class of stems it marks.

ws.description: Writing system tag of the name and abbreviation.

project.description: Known project name or recorded .fwdata path.

name: motif_edit_exception_features
description:
Set exception features. Research first: motif_guide topic suffix-prefix-slots; check best practice. For a stem, clitic or inflectional affix. A derivational affix uses compose-edit-derivational-affix-restriction (guides suffix-prefix-slots). Sets the exact exception features a stem or clitic carries, or the ones an inflectional affix requires of its stem. An empty list clears the set. Derivational affixes use their own command. Motif stages a Draft for a person to review and Apply.
Command: compose-edit-exception-features. Agent class: Draft.

msa.description: Id of the grammatical info of a stem, clitic or inflectional affix entry.

exceptionFeatures.description: Exact set of exception feature ids; an empty list removes them all.

project.description: Known project name or recorded .fwdata path.

name: motif_edit_phonological_rule_features
description:
Set rule features. Research first: motif_guide topic suffix-prefix-slots; check best practice. For a rule that exists. Tag the stems with compose-edit-exception-features first. Sets the exact exception features or inflection classes a phonological rewrite rule requires of a stem, and the ones it excludes. An empty list clears a set. Motif stages a Draft for a person to review and Apply.
Command: compose-edit-phonological-rule-features. Agent class: Draft.

rule.description: Id of an existing regular rule with one right-hand side; for several, use compose-edit-phonological-rule with rightHandSides.

requiredFeatures.description: Exact set of exception feature or inflection class ids a stem must all carry; an empty list clears it.

excludedFeatures.description: Exact set of ids a stem must carry none of; an empty list clears it.

project.description: Known project name or recorded .fwdata path.

name: motif_edit_compound_rule
description:
Turn a compound rule off or on. Research first: motif_guide topic workflow or ask-the-linguist; check best practice. Only turns existing compounding off or on; it builds and fixes nothing. Trial known compounds before and after, and ask the linguist first (guide workflow). Stages one explicit Disabled value for an endocentric or exocentric compound rule in a Draft. FieldWorks compound rules join any two stems, so a rule that builds non-words can be switched off; the expected value guards against stale evidence, and only a person can Apply.
Command: compose-edit-compound-rule. Agent class: Draft.

target.description: Id of the compound rule to turn off or on.

expectedDisabled.description: Whether the rule is turned off now: true when it is, false when it is on.

disabled.description: Whether the rule should be turned off: true to turn it off, false to turn it on.

project.description: Known project name or recorded .fwdata path.

name: motif_set_no_default_compounding
description:
Set default compounding. Research first: motif_guide topic workflow; check best practice. Only turns the parser's built-in default compounding off or on; it authors no compound rule. Trial known compounds first and ask the linguist (guide workflow). Stages one explicit change to the parser's built-in default compounding in a Draft. A project with no compound rules of its own still has the parser join any two stems unless default compounding is turned off; the expected value guards against stale evidence, and only a person can Apply.
Command: compose-set-no-default-compounding. Agent class: Draft.

expectedNoDefaultCompounding.description: Whether default compounding is turned off now: true when it is, false when it is on.

noDefaultCompounding.description: Whether default compounding should be turned off: true to turn it off, false to turn it on.

project.description: Known project name or recorded .fwdata path.

name: motif_set_not_on_clitics
description:
Set rules on clitics. Research first: motif_guide topic workflow or ask-the-linguist; check best practice. Only chooses where phonological rules run relative to clitics; it authors no rule or clitic. Trial clitic words first and ask the linguist (guide workflow). Stages one explicit change to whether the parser's phonological rules also run on a word with its clitic attached. By default the rules run on the word before a clitic attaches; the expected value guards against stale evidence, and only a person can Apply.
Command: compose-set-not-on-clitics. Agent class: Draft.

expectedNotOnClitics.description: Whether the rules stay off the clitic now: true when they do (also when the project never set it), false when they run on the clitic.

notOnClitics.description: Whether the rules should stay off the clitic: true to run them before a clitic attaches, false to run them on the word with its clitic.

project.description: Known project name or recorded .fwdata path.

name: motif_add_circumfix
description:
Author a circumfix. Research first: motif_guide topic workflow or suffix-prefix-slots; check best practice. Use when one meaning is marked on both sides of the stem at once. Markers that can occur apart are two entries in slots (guide suffix-prefix-slots). Stages a new circumfix entry as FieldWorks holds it: one entry whose prefix part and suffix part attach to a stem together, with one sense and one grammatical analysis. The parser pairs the two parts, so neither part alone attaches. Dry Run and Trial before a person Applies the Proposal. In a compose-batch file its two parts are labelled @label:prefix and @label:suffix.
Command: compose-author-circumfix. Agent class: Draft.

prefix.description: The prefix part, in the vernacular writing system formWs, without hyphens (for example ke for ke-...-an).

suffix.description: The suffix part, in formWs, without hyphens (for example an).

formWs.description: Vernacular writing system tag for both parts.

analysisWs.description: Analysis writing system tag for the gloss and definition.

msa.description: Affix grammatical info: kind inflectional, derivational or unclassified, its category, for derivational also toCategory, and for inflectional also slots.

prefixEnvironments.description: Optional ids of environments the prefix part occurs in; absent means any. Any environment on a circumfix part is unreliable, because it is tested against both parts; leave the part unconditioned.

suffixEnvironments.description: Optional ids of environments the suffix part occurs in; absent means any. Any environment on a circumfix part is unreliable, because it is tested against both parts; leave the part unconditioned or model the short form as its own entry.

inflectionClasses.description: Optional ids of inflection classes both parts attach to; inflectional and unclassified affixes only.

project.description: Known project name or recorded .fwdata path.

name: motif_add_morphosyntax_analysis
description:
Add a grammatical analysis. Research first: motif_guide topic suffix-prefix-slots or workflow; check best practice. Use when one form serves two categories. Changing the one analysis an entry has from one affix kind to another: compose-change-affix-kind. A brand-new entry: compose-author-lexical-entry. Stages one more grammatical info on an entry that already has one, as FieldWorks holds it: an entry owns any number of analyses, each sense points at one, and the parser loads every analysis of the entry as its own rule or stem. One suffix entry can then serve two categories. A derivational analysis can name its one From inflection class, so an entry with one analysis per class attaches to several classes. The new analysis can take existing senses of the entry, a new sense with a gloss, or neither. It refuses a stem analysis on an affix, an affix analysis on a stem, and a sense that belongs to another entry. Dry Run and Trial before a person Applies the Proposal.
Command: compose-add-morphosyntax-analysis. Agent class: Draft.

entry.description: Id of the existing or earlier-staged entry that gains the analysis.

msa.description: The new grammatical info: kind stem, inflectional, derivational or unclassified to suit the entry's form, its category, for derivational also toCategory, for inflectional also slots, for a stem also inflectionClass and exceptionFeatures (existing exception feature ids).

senses.description: Optional ids of senses of this entry that should point at the new analysis instead of the one they have.

gloss.description: Optional gloss for a new sense that points at the new analysis; goes with analysisWs.

analysisWs.description: Analysis writing system tag of the new sense's gloss and definition.

definition.description: Optional definition of the new sense; needs gloss.

fromInflectionClass.description: Optional id of the one inflection class, of the derivational analysis's From category or an ancestor, that stems must belong to.

project.description: Known project name or recorded .fwdata path.

name: motif_set_entry_do_not_parse
description:
Set entry parsing flag. Research first: motif_guide topic workflow or ask-the-linguist; check best practice. The flag changes no parse, so it does not retire an entry. To stop a stem parsing, retype or delete it. Stages the FieldWorks do-not-parse flag on a lexical entry. The flag does not stop the entry parsing: PanGloss, FieldWorks HermitCrab and XAmple all parse a flagged entry, whole entry and not just compounds; to stop a stem parsing, retype it with compose-set-stem-part-of-speech or delete it.
Command: compose-set-entry-do-not-parse. Agent class: Draft.

target.description: Id of the lexical entry.

expectedDoNotParse.description: The flag value currently stored on the entry.

doNotParse.description: The flag value to store: true to mark the entry do-not-parse, false to clear it.

project.description: Known project name or recorded .fwdata path.

name: motif_rewrite_lexeme_form
description:
Rewrite lexeme forms. Research first: motif_guide topic conditioned-allomorphs; check best practice. Keep variants of one morpheme under one entry with narrow conditions. Not for a regular sound change across forms: use a phonological rule (guide nasal-assimilation). Rewrites existing lexeme forms with expected-current guards while preserving their identities and references. Give explicit new forms to retain underlying distinctions until ordered grammar rules realize running spelling; Motif stages a Draft for a person to review and Apply.
Command: compose-rewrite-lexeme-form. Agent class: Draft.

entries.description: The entries to rewrite, each with entryGuid, writingSystem, expectedForm and newForm; a current form that differs from expectedForm refuses the whole batch.

setEmptyCitationForm.description: When true, an entry with no citation form in that writing system gets its old lexeme form as the citation form.

foldStressMarks.description: When true, omit newForm: it is computed from expectedForm by removing U+0300, U+0301, U+0302, U+0304 and U+030C only. This destructive spelling fold is not phonological realization; use false and explicit newForm when distinctions condition grammar.

project.description: Known project name or recorded .fwdata path.

name: motif_edit_allomorph_form
description:
Edit an allomorph form. Research first: motif_guide topic conditioned-allomorphs; check best practice. Edit an existing ordinary alternate in place. For a regular change across forms, use a phonological rule. Changes one writing-system alternative of a selected ordinary stem or affix alternate after checking its owner and current form. Keeps the form identity, conditions and references; stages a Draft for a person to review and Apply.
Command: compose-edit-allomorph-form. Agent class: Draft.

target.description: Existing ordinary alternate form ID; lexeme forms use compose-rewrite-lexeme-form.

expectedForm.description: Current text required for this edit, compared by canonical Unicode equivalence.

newForm.description: Replacement, or an empty string to clear this alternative; no accent, quantity or segment folding is performed.

project.description: Known project name or recorded .fwdata path.

name: motif_edit_citation_form
description:
Edit a citation form. Research first: motif_guide topic conditioned-allomorphs; check best practice. Retain the selected source headword here. Parser forms need represented underlying distinctions and ordered rules for written realization. Writes a selected source headword in one Citation Form alternative after checking its current text. Leaves parser forms and other writing-system alternatives intact; stages a Draft for a person to review and Apply.
Command: compose-edit-citation-form. Agent class: Draft.

target.description: Existing lexical entry ID.

expectedForm.description: Current Citation Form; use an empty string when absent.

newForm.description: Selected source headword to retain, or an empty string to clear this alternative.

project.description: Known project name or recorded .fwdata path.

name: motif_edit_definition
description:
Edit Definition. Stages the full meaning of a sense in Definition, checking the current text separately in each writing system. Empty replacement text clears that alternative; review the Draft before a person Applies it.
Command: compose-edit-definition. Agent class: Draft.

target.description: Canonical identity of the existing sense.

alternatives.description: Nonempty list of writingSystem, expectedText and text. All three strings are required, including empty text. A stale expectedText refuses the whole edit.

project.description: Known project name or recorded .fwdata path.

name: motif_edit_gloss
description:
Edit Gloss. Stages the short translation equivalent of a sense in Gloss, checking the current text separately in each writing system. Use Definition for the full meaning; empty replacement text clears an alternative.
Command: compose-edit-gloss. Agent class: Draft.

target.description: Canonical identity of the existing sense.

alternatives.description: Nonempty list of writingSystem, expectedText and text. All three strings are required, including empty text. A stale expectedText refuses the whole edit.

name: motif_edit_lexical_note
description:
Edit lexical notes. Stages an entry Note or a named sense note, checking the current text separately in each writing system. Record example words for an affix and its allomorphs in the entry Note; only a person can Apply.
Command: compose-edit-lexical-note. Agent class: Draft.

field.description: note for an entry, or anthropology-note, discourse-note, general-note, grammar-note, phonology-note, semantics-note or sociolinguistics-note for a sense.
